scope: Phase 6 Chromium; live and scripted modes separated

cases.name: [security] exact API origin, frontend origin and Host denials enforce local boundary
[scripted] hostile finding, path, Markdown and agent content remain inert and redacted
[scripted] pending triage polling reports actual states and safe provider failure
[scripted] unavailable triage and failed scanner never appear clean
[scripted] loading, unavailable API retry and empty filtered finding states
[security] frontend modules and artifacts cannot read private configuration or persist credentials
[security] malformed and oversized API responses fail visibly within bounds
[scripted] background pending-scan refresh preserves unsaved human draft and focus
[live] memory-only authentication, disconnect, reload and no implicit writes
[live] invalid bearer is denied without exposing credentials
[live] history pagination, exact filters and metrics from loaded persisted records
[live] partial scan preserves findings and exposes incomplete scanner coverage
[live] empty project and invalid identifiers have usable safe states
[live] explicit deterministic triage has genuine evidence and no automatic human decision
[live] synthetic diagnostic and insufficient-evidence abstention stay explicit
[live] unsupported real vulnerability family abstains without inflating reasoning coverage
[live] two sessions preserve conflicts, confirmed revisions, feedback and paginated immutable history
[live] responsive keyboard workflow and labels remain usable
[live] hosted execution remains denied and no provider key is exposed
